We value your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how San3a collects, uses, and protects your information.
1. Information We Collect Personal Data: Name, phone number, location, profile photo, ID (for craftsmen). Usage Data: How you interact with the app, device type, IP address. Photos & Files: Only those you upload voluntarily for service requests or profile verification.
2. How We Use Your Information To connect customers with suitable craftsmen. To improve app performance and user experience. To verify identities and prevent fraud. To send important updates or notifications.
3. Data Sharing We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties except: When required by law. To enable in-app messaging and job assignment between users. For payment processing (if integrated).
4. Location Data We collect your location to: Show you nearby services or job requests. Help you navigate to job locations. You can disable location sharing at any time in your device settings.
5. Security We use encryption and secure storage methods to protect your data. However, no system is 100% secure.
6. Your Rights You can: Access and edit your profile at any time. Request deletion of your data by contacting us at support@san3a.com.
7. Policy Updates We may revise this policy from time to time. You will be notified of significant changes.
